backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access control, user approval, admin allowlist, and daily service report storage with admin‑gated actions and full system reset.
feature_evidence.json: Lists feature evidence records mapping features to source files, components, and test IDs for traceability.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing frontend file purposes, behaviors, and recent changes.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA into an Android TWA app using Bubblewrap or manual Android Studio setup.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for IC mainnet including build version requirements, upgrade steps, and post-deploy tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH industrial theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the app root, manifest, icons, and main React script.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, colors, start URL, display mode, and required icons.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker handles versioned precaching, runtime caching, cache cleanup, skip-waiting messages, and network-first or cache-first fetch behavior.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Router routes, query client, and an admin route guard for restricting admin pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays a restricted-access message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation bar showing user info, navigation links, admin options, and logout handling.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper providing header, footer, banners, and main content area.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login UI for Internet Identity sign-in with error handling and status display.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows an offline warning banner when network connectivity is lost.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Signup form for engineers and admins with validation, role selection, and backend mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Shows a banner when a new service worker version is available and provides an update action.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session error screen with a button to reload the page.
frontend/src/components/SignupPendingAcc: UI screen showing pending account activation with a retry button that refetches the current user profile query.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides a comprehensive logout routine clearing queries, identity, storage, caches, and optionally reloading the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook for one-time geolocation capture with error handling, optional auto-capture, and state reset.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider managing Internet Identity authentication, login flow, and stored identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Tracks online/offline browser network status with event listeners.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, admin state, and reports via the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Detects service worker updates and exposes a method to apply them and trigger a page reload.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light and dark theme CSS variables and base styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting users, viewing reports, and resetting the app with access control.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form for creating new service reports with validation and optional geolocation capture.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists and filters service reports with search, date range, user filtering, and CSV export.
frontend/src/utils/authClientIndexedDbCl: Best‑effort utility to delete Internet Identity–related IndexedDB databases during logout.
frontend/src/utils/authClientPersistentL: Creates a fresh AuthClient and logs it out to clear persisted session state, swallowing all errors.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Detects missing-profile, pending-access, and genuine authentication errors using message pattern checks.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all localStorage and sessionStorage entries in a safe, non-throwing way.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates a build version string from environment variables or module URL and provides a display helper.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the modern API with a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs and usernames for display and provides a full-principal passthrough.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears all PWA caches and unregisters service workers using best‑effort, timeout‑guarded cleanup.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a browser download with a date-based filename.
Maps backend signup errors to friendly messages and sanitizes technical or sensitive details.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes sensitive data and logs signup flow events without exposing secrets or PII.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Provides simple validation for required fields, email format, and mobile numbers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL or storage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, animations, and container settings, and enabling typography, container queries, and animation plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s state, features, and pending requests related to removing Internet Identity and supporting anonymous mode.
